description: Flat per-sample metadata schema for 18S rRNA marker-gene sequencing of microbial eukaryotic communities in freshwater lakes, including sampling context, environmental variables, and collection details.

sample_id.descr: Unique identifier for the individual sample or record.

study_id.descr: Identifier for the project or study under which the sample was generated.

lake_id.descr: Unique identifier or name of the lake from which the sample was collected.

lake_region.descr: Geographic region, basin, country, or subnational area where the lake is located.

site_id.descr: Identifier for the sampling station, site, or location within the lake.

site_description.descr: Free-text description of the sampling location, such as nearshore, pelagic, inlet, outlet, or central basin.

sampling_date.descr: Date of sample collection in ISO format (YYYY-MM-DD).

sampling_time.descr: Time of sample collection, preferably in 24-hour local time or UTC if standardized.

season.descr: Season at time of sampling, such as spring, summer, autumn/fall, or winter.

lake_zone.descr: Ecological or spatial zone within the lake, such as littoral, pelagic, profundal, epilimnion, metalimnion, hypolimnion, inlet, outlet, or benthic.

depth_m.descr: Sampling depth in meters below the water surface.

depth_zone.descr: Depth category if applicable, such as surface, mid-water, deep, epilimnetic, or bottom-water.

water_temperature_c.descr: Water temperature at the sampling point in degrees Celsius.

dissolved_oxygen_mg_l.descr: Dissolved oxygen concentration in milligrams per liter (mg/L).

dissolved_oxygen_pct_sat.descr: Dissolved oxygen as percent saturation, if measured.

ph.descr: Water pH measured at the sampling point.

conductivity_us_cm.descr: Electrical conductivity in microsiemens per centimeter (µS/cm).

secchi_depth_m.descr: Secchi depth in meters, if measured.

chlorophyll_a_ug_l.descr: Chlorophyll a concentration in micrograms per liter (µg/L), if measured.

nitrate_mg_l.descr: Nitrate concentration expressed as mg/L as N or reported explicitly in the accompanying documentation.

nitrite_mg_l.descr: Nitrite concentration in mg/L as N, if measured.

ammonium_mg_l.descr: Ammonium concentration in mg/L as N, if measured.

total_nitrogen_mg_l.descr: Total nitrogen concentration in mg/L, if measured.

phosphate_mg_l.descr: Orthophosphate or soluble reactive phosphorus concentration in mg/L as P, if measured.

total_phosphorus_mg_l.descr: Total phosphorus concentration in mg/L, if measured.

dissolved_organic_carbon_mg_l.descr: Dissolved organic carbon concentration in mg/L, if measured.

sample_matrix.descr: Material sampled; typically freshwater, water column, surface water, or sediment if included.

sample_volume_l.descr: Volume of water filtered or collected for DNA extraction, in liters.

filter_pore_size_um.descr: Filter pore size in micrometers used to collect biomass, if filtration was used.

filter_material.descr: Filter membrane material, such as GF/F, cellulose nitrate, PES, nylon, or polycarbonate.

preservation_method.descr: Method used to preserve the sample prior to DNA extraction, such as frozen, ethanol-preserved, RNAlater, or dried.

storage_temperature_c.descr: Storage temperature in degrees Celsius prior to extraction.

dna_extraction_method.descr: DNA extraction kit, protocol, or method used for the sample.

marker_gene.descr: Target marker gene amplified; for this study, 18S rRNA gene.

amplicon_region.descr: Specific amplified region within the 18S rRNA gene, such as V4 or V9.

forward_primer.descr: Forward primer sequence or primer name used for amplification.

reverse_primer.descr: Reverse primer sequence or primer name used for amplification.

sequencing_platform.descr: Sequencing platform used, such as Illumina MiSeq, NovaSeq, or Ion Torrent.

library_strategy.descr: Library preparation strategy, such as amplicon sequencing or indexed PCR amplicon library.

replicate_type.descr: Replicate category, such as biological replicate, technical replicate, field duplicate, or none.

replicate_number.descr: Replicate number or replicate index for the sample.

operator.descr: Person or laboratory responsible for collecting, processing, or sequencing the sample.

quality_flag.descr: Indicator of sample or metadata quality, such as pass, warning, excluded, or needs review.

notes.descr: Additional free-text notes relevant to the sample, including deviations from protocol or unusual field conditions.
